') center/cover no-repeat; z-index: 0;
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(4,12,32,0.94) 0%, rgba(4,12,32,0.80) 45%, rgba(4,12,32,0.42) 100%);
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .hero-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
  .eyebrow { color: #ff6a63; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(40px, 5.4vw, 70px); line-height: 1.03; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.025em; margin-bottom: 22px; max-width: 820px; }
  .hero h1 .light { font-weight: 300; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.74); display: block; margin-top: 6px; }
  .hero p { font-size: 17px; max-width: 610px; opacity: 0.92; margin-bottom: 24px; line-height: 1.55; }
  .hero-rating { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 34px; font-size: 14px; }
  .hero-rating .stars { color: var(--gold); letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: 16px; }
  .hero-rating .rating-txt { opacity: 0.9; }
  .hero-rating .rating-txt strong { font-weight: 700; }
  .hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn { display: inline-block; padding: 17px 30px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; border: 2px solid transparent; transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer; }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--red); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--red); }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--red-hover); border-color: var(--red-hover); }
  .btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }
  .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

  .pillars { background: var(--cream); padding: 80px 40px; }
  .pillars-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 44px; }
  .pillar-num { color: var(--red); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .pillar h3 { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 12px; line-height: 1.25; }
  .pillar p { color: var(--text-mute); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; }

  .process { padding: 80px 40px; background: var(--white); }
  .process-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .section-eyebrow { color: var(--red); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .process h2, .reviews h2, .gallery h2 { font-size: clamp(28px, 3.8vw, 40px); font-weight: 800; color: var(--navy); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 10px; max-width: 760px; }
  .section-sub { color: var(--text-mute); font-size: 16px; max-width: 660px; margin-bottom: 44px; line-height: 1.55; }
  .steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .step { position: relative; padding-top: 22px; border-top: 3px solid var(--red); }
  .step .step-num { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .step h3 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .step p { color: var(--text-mute); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

  /* ============ SLIDING GALLERY ============ */
  .gallery { padding: 80px 0 80px; background: var(--cream); }
  .gallery-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; }
  .gallery-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .slider-controls { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 44px; }
  .slider-controls button { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--navy); background: var(--white); color: var(--navy); font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  .slider-controls button:hover { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; }
  .slider {
    display: flex; gap: 18px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    padding: 4px 40px 24px; scroll-padding-left: 40px; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .slider::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 8px; }
  .slider::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(6,27,88,0.28); border-radius: 4px; }
  .slide {
    flex: 0 0 clamp(280px, 42vw, 460px); scroll-snap-align: start;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px;
    background: #dcd6ca center/cover no-repeat; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(6,27,88,0.14);
  }
  .slide .tag { position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 14px; z-index: 2; background: var(--red); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 6px 11px; border-radius: 3px; }
  .slide .cap { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; z-index: 2; padding: 40px 18px 16px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(4,12,32,0.9)); color: #fff; }
  .slide .cap b { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; }
  .slide .cap span { font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.8; }
  .slide.placeholder {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #e7e1d5, #e7e1d5 12px, #ddd6c8 12px, #ddd6c8 24px);
    border: 1px dashed rgba(6,27,88,0.4);
  }
  .slide.placeholder p { color: var(--navy); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 20px; opacity: 0.85; line-height: 1.5; }

  /* ============ REVIEWS ============ */
  .reviews { padding: 80px 40px; background: var(--white); }
  .reviews-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .reviews-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 40px; }
  .reviews-head .headings { max-width: 640px; }
  .rating-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 16px 22px; border-radius: 4px; }
  .rating-badge .score { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--navy); line-height: 1; }
  .rating-badge .stars { color: var(--gold); font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .rating-badge .meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-mute); margin-top: 4px; }
  .review-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
  .review-card { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; padding: 26px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .review-card .stars { color: var(--gold); font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .review-card blockquote { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 18px; flex: 1; }
  .review-card .who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  .review-card .avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--navy); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .review-card .name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: var(--navy); }
  .review-card .loc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-mute); }
  .review-card .src { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-mute); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
  .review-card.placeholder { border-style: dashed; border-color: rgba(6,27,88,0.35); background: var(--cream); }
  .review-card.placeholder blockquote { color: var(--text-mute); font-style: italic; }

  .trust-row { background: var(--navy); color: var(--white); padding: 34px 40px; }
  .trust-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 18px; text-align: center; }
  .trust-item .big { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff; line-height: 1.1; }
  .trust-item .lbl { font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.7; margin-top: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

  .form-section { background: var(--navy); color: var(--white); padding: 80px 40px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
  .form-inner { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .form-section h2 { font-size: clamp(28px, 3.8vw, 40px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .form-section p.lead { font-size: 16px; opacity: 0.78; margin-bottom: 36px; max-width: 600px; line-height: 1.55; }
  .form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; }
  .form-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .form-group.full { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .form-group label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.85; }
  .form-group label .hint { font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.55; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .form-group input, .form-group select {
    padding: 14px 16px; font-size: 15px; font-family: inherit;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color: var(--white); border-radius: 0; -webkit-appearance: none; -moz-appearance: none; appearance: none;
  }
  .form-group input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
  .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--red); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); }
  .form-group select { background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='12' height='8'><path d='M0 0l6 8 6-8z' fill='%23fff' opacity='.55'/></svg>"); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: calc(100% - 18px) center; padding-right: 44px; }
  .form-submit { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: 12px; }
  .form-submit button { width: 100%; padding: 20px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; background: var(--red); color: var(--white); border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; }
  .form-submit button:hover { background: var(--red-hover); }
  .form-submit button:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: wait; }
  .form-trust-line { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.7; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .form-trust-line .stars { color: var(--gold); letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .form-success { padding: 40px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left: 4px solid var(--red); text-align: center; display: none; margin-top: 24px; }
  .form-success h3 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .form-success p { opacity: 0.85; }
  .form-fine { margin-top: 28px; font-size: 12px; opacity: 0.55; }
  .form-fine a { color: var(--white); }

  .footer { background: var(--navy-deep); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); padding: 32px 40px; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
  .footer strong { color: var(--white); }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    .trust-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 26px 18px; }
    .review-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 800px) {
    .site-header { padding: 12px 18px; }
    .brand img { height: 38px; }
    .hero { padding: 56px 20px 60px; }
    .pillars, .form-section, .process, .reviews { padding: 56px 20px; }
    .gallery { padding: 56px 0; }
    .gallery-inner { padding: 0 20px; }
    .slider { padding: 4px 20px 22px; scroll-padding-left: 20px; }
    .pillars-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
    .steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-ctas { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
    .btn { text-align: center; }
    .reviews-head { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
  }
  .form-group input.is-invalid, .form-group select.is-invalid { border-color: #ff6b4a; background: rgba(255,107,74,0.08); }
  .field-error { color: #ff8f75; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 7px; }
  .submit-error { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin-top: 14px; padding: 14px 16px; background: rgba(255,107,74,0.10); border-left: 3px solid #ff6b4a; color: #ffc4b4; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; }
  .submit-error a { color: var(--
